name: b_g014
description: B-G014: multi-week exact-replica G0 for twap_mr_v1 from the 1m candle store. Frozen 2026-06-12 while the store held ~3.7d — before the deciding sample existed. Arms are the backlog-prescribed three configs (live baseline; stop_loss_pct 0.03 from B-EXIT; vwap_window 240 from B-WIN), each judged taker AND maker-rest; combos excluded (stop+window is anti-synergistic, Iter 33).
decision: A live-flip proposal requires an arm to PASS G0 AND beat the baseline arm of the same execution basis on OOS edge over this >=14d sample. Maker claims count ONLY from the maker_fill=resting arms (optimistic maker fills flipped the sign of the whole maker case, Iters 50-51); B-MAKER-LIVE additionally requires the maker-rest arm to beat the same-config taker arm. If baseline-taker FAILS on >=2 weeks, the Iter-29 3.5d PASS was the recent regime pocket: propose nothing, twap_mr_v1 stays as-is and B-MAKER-LIVE stays blocked. Any flip is a live strategy change — operator-gated, never loop-applied.
